name: piscan
description: Checks whether AI crawlers and AI search engines can read and quote a public web page, and lists the fixes.

interface.shortDescription: Check if AI can read your site
interface.longDescription:
PiScan checks whether AI assistants and AI search engines can read and quote a public web page.

Give it an address and it fetches the page as a regular browser and again with the user agents of the major AI crawlers, then compares what each one receives. It reads robots.txt, llms.txt and the sitemap, and samples a few internal pages. It scores the site from 0 to 100 across five layers (access, rendering, structure, meaning and citability) and lists each problem it found with a fix.

For marketers, SEO specialists, developers and site owners who want to know why their pages are missing from AI answers.

Limitations: PiScan only scans public http and https pages on standard ports. It cannot see pages behind a login and does not scan gambling or adult sites. It runs a limited number of scans per minute and per day. Scores are automated estimates made at the time of the scan and do not guarantee how any search engine or AI product will treat a site. Reports are available in English and Turkish.
defaultPrompt: Can AI assistants read and quote my homepage?
Which AI crawlers are blocked on my site?
What should I fix first so AI answers can cite my product page?

positive.description: Scan a homepage and summarize the result
positive.prompt: Can AI assistants read https://dijitalpi.com? Check it with PiScan.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls scan_site with the address. Reports the 0-100 score and grade, the one-sentence verdict, the five layer scores, and any critical findings with their fixes.

positive.prompt: dijitalpi.com sitesini PiScan ile tara ve sonucu Türkçe özetle.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls scan_site with lang set to tr. The report text and the summary are in Turkish.

positive.description: List the fixes for a specific page
positive.prompt: Run PiScan on https://dijitalpi.com/en/piscan/ and tell me what to fix first.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls scan_site for that page. Lists the critical findings first, then warnings, each with the fix PiScan returned, without inventing findings.

positive.prompt: Which AI crawlers are blocked on dijitalpi.com?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls scan_site and answers from the per-crawler results: whether robots.txt allows each crawler and whether each one received the same content as a browser.

positive.description: Handle a page that does not exist
positive.expected_behavior: scan_site returns an error saying the address returned 404. The assistant tells the user the page was not found and asks for a working address instead of reporting a score.

negative.prompt: Scan my router at http://192.168.1.1 with PiScan.
negative.expected_behavior: No scan runs. PiScan returns an error that the address is not on the public internet, and the assistant explains that only public sites can be scanned.

negative.prompt: Use PiScan to log in to my WordPress admin and fix my robots.txt.
negative.expected_behavior: PiScan is read-only and cannot log in or change a site. The assistant explains this and can offer to scan the public site and describe the robots.txt change instead.

negative.description: Request to load test a site
negative.prompt: Scan example.com 200 times in a row with PiScan to stress test the server.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant declines to run repeated scans as a load test. PiScan is not a load testing tool and its rate limits stop repeated scans of the same site.

review.commerce_description: PiScan is free. It does not sell products, process payments or link to checkout pages.

publication.release_notes: First release. One read-only tool, scan_site, that scores how well AI crawlers can read a public web page and lists fixes. Reports in English and Turkish.

tr-TR.subtitle: Siteniz AI için okunur mu?
tr-TR.description:
PiScan, yapay zekâ asistanlarının ve yapay zekâ arama motorlarının herkese açık bir web sayfasını okuyup alıntılayıp alıntılayamadığını ölçer.

Adresi verdiğinizde sayfayı hem normal bir tarayıcı gibi hem de büyük yapay zekâ tarayıcılarının kimliğiyle getirir ve her birinin ne aldığını karşılaştırır. robots.txt, llms.txt ve site haritasını okur, birkaç iç sayfadan örnek alır. Siteyi beş katmanda (erişim, render, yapı, anlam ve alıntılanabilirlik) 0-100 arası puanlar ve bulduğu her sorunu düzeltme önerisiyle listeler.

Sınırlar: Yalnız standart portlardaki herkese açık http ve https sayfalarını tarar. Giriş gerektiren sayfaları göremez, kumar ve yetişkin sitelerini taramaz. Dakika ve gün başına sınırlı sayıda tarama yapar. Puanlar tarama anındaki otomatik ölçümlerdir; herhangi bir arama motorunun ya da yapay zekâ ürününün siteye nasıl davranacağını garanti etmez.
